description: Source code for the Overlay class used in Android's screen recording feature, handling rendering overlays, system property display, and frame processing.

classes.name: Overlay
classes.description: Handles overlay rendering, frame processing, and system info display for Android screen recording.

methods.name: Overlay::start
methods.description: Initializes overlay, starts rendering thread, and sets output surface.

methods.name: Overlay::threadLoop
methods.description: Main loop for overlay thread, processes frames when available.

methods.name: Overlay::setup_l
methods.description: Sets up EGL window, shaders, textures, and buffer consumers.

methods.name: Overlay::processFrame_l
methods.description: Processes a frame: updates texture, renders overlay, and draws timestamp.

methods.name: Overlay::getTimeString_l
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string based on monotonic or real time.

methods.name: Overlay::onFrameAvailable
methods.description: Callback triggered when a new frame is available.

methods.name: Overlay::drawInfoPage
methods.description: Draws an informational overlay page with system properties and GL info.

methods.name: Overlay::doDrawInfoPage
methods.description: Helper to render the info page with borders, text, and system info.
